title: Warp
content: Ok so I had a lucid dream last night and wanted to go to the mall but I couldn’t for whatever reason. My dream was based on my home street but I was wondering if anybody feels and sees a warp like tunnel before you actually “arrive” to your dream . It’s hard to explain but I lose control and I’m aware I’m asleep and about to end up in a dream world . The best way I can describe it is Marvel’s Ant-Man and the quantum realm . It’s like I’m being sucked through a tunnel out of reality into my dreams . Last night was the first time I actually had an “oh shit I’m here , this is happening “ feeling through the warp. I was falling and couldn’t do anything but just let my dream progress . It’s kinda cool but also a bit creepy lol anybody else ???
